title: Decoder recursion on nonempty words
statement: For every nonempty bit string $w$, its decoded list of words is the first projection of the pair parser applied to $w$, followed by the decoded list of words obtained from the second projection of that parse.
hypotheses_covered: The input bit string $w$ is nonempty.
